meta.title: Reject the vendor's own bid without "Allow seller to bid again"
gaps: The prepared state contains only one invited vendor and one bid, so Vendor B's bid, Vendor B moving up, and the two-vendor ranking cannot be tested.
The prepared state is a live/bid or closed fixture rather than the specifically requested RFQ-in-evaluation setup.
No catalog step verifies that the rejected bid cannot be awarded or that a second vendor becomes awardable after rejection.
The exact rejection confirmation control label is not specified by the catalog.
The catalog cannot prove the block remains effective after extending the event time.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state contains only one invited vendor and one bid, so Vendor B's bid, Vendor B moving up, and the two-vendor ranking cannot be tested.; The prepared state is a live/bid or closed fixture rather than the specifically requested RFQ-in-evaluation setup.; No catalog step verifies that the rejected bid cannot be awarded or that a second vendor becomes awardable after rejection.; The exact rejection confirmation control label is not specified by the catalog.; The catalog cannot prove the block remains effective after extending the event time.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's RFQ Responses tab as required for this prepared-state case.
Open rejection for Vendor A's bid.
Assert that the reject-bid confirmation dialog opened.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog names Vendor A and asks for confirmation.

args.text: Supplier would not be allowed to bid again. This action cannot be undone.

steps.note: Verify the warning for permanently blocking re-bidding.
Confirm the rejection using the dialog's confirmation control.

args.text: You have blocked the supplier from bidding again.

steps.note: Assert the buyer received the blocked-supplier confirmation.
Open the Rejected Bids list from the RFQ stage settings.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Assert the rejected bid is listed with the supplied remark.
Switch to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event overview so the vendor-side rejection status and reason can be read.
Assert the vendor sees the rejection reason.
Assert the vendor sees the bid as rejected.
Verify the blocked vendor cannot submit another bid.
